title: Zero-Cost Public Odds Web Collector
decision_rule: Production requires explicit automation permission, clear commercial data rights, verifiable named bookmaker full-time 1X2, five-league future-fixture coverage, point-in-time freshness and fixture-targeted access. Unknown is not yes. Robots permission alone is not a data license.
